csharpCode: var controller = player.GetComponent<CharacterController>(); var renderers = player.GetComponentsInChildren<Renderer>(); var visualMin = float.PositiveInfinity; foreach (var renderer in renderers) if (renderer.gameObject.activeInHierarchy) visualMin = Mathf.Min(visualMin, renderer.bounds.min.y); var hits = Physics.RaycastAll(player.transform.position + Vector3.up * 1000f, Vector3.down, 2000f, Physics.DefaultRaycastLayers, QueryTriggerInteraction.Ignore); RaycastHit groundHit = new RaycastHit(); var foundGround = false; foreach (var hit in hits) { if (!hit.collider.transform.IsChildOf(player.transform)) { groundHit = hit; foundGround = true; break; } } Debug.Log("[GroundDiagnostic] playerY=" + player.transform.position.y + " controllerBottom=" + controller.bounds.min.y + " visualFeet=" + visualMin + " groundY=" + (foundGround ? groundHit.point.y.ToString() : "none") + " ground=" + (foundGround ? groundHit.collider.name : "none"));
